DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_twosided_realMask_trace.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ)
  (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]
  (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (rho : X → ℝ) (hm : Measurable rho)
  (hbound : ∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ rho x ∧ rho x ≤ 1) :
  have M := KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM nu rho hm hbound;
  Integrable (fun x => ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x * ↑(rho x)) nu ∧
    ∫ (x : X), ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x * ↑(rho x) ∂nu =
      Masullo.TraceClass.trace (M.comp (E.starProjection.comp (A.comp M)))
'DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_twosided_realMask_trace' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
HArithmeticTrace.both_tests_full_source_twosided_smooth_trace.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2)
  (L epsilon : ℝ) :
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let V := JThetaAttachment.fullSourceSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have rho := FSmoothCutoff.mask K L epsilon;
  have M := KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (FSmoothCutoff.realMask K L epsilon) ⋯ ⋯;
  ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
    Integrable (fun x => rho x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x * rho x) mu ∧
      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), rho x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x * rho x ∂mu =
          Masullo.TraceClass.trace (M.comp ((E T).starProjection.comp (A.comp M))) ∧
        ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            rho x *
                DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A (fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹)) x x *
              rho x ∂mu =
          -Masullo.TraceClass.trace (M.comp ((E T).starProjection.comp (A.comp M)))
